verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state developers can use Pipedream MCP for free in 'development mode' and that Pipedream offers 'a generous free plan and free access to Pipedream Connect while in development,' directly supporting free-tier prototyping of tool connections before paying. Missing for 10: independent/third-party confirmation of the free tier's practical limits and no detail on specific usage caps or when paid tier becomes required.
